strings.name: Lakshmi Mittal
strings.summary: Mittal began in his family's steel business, established operations in Indonesia in 1976 and consolidated steel assets through cross-border acquisitions. He drove the 2006 Arcelor merger and became executive chairman in 2021 as Aditya became CEO. Expansion brought labor, safety and lobbying controversies. A Kazakh mine disaster killed 46 people in 2023; the company sold its local business that year.
